reviewPolicy: This is a reviewed classification of axe's limitations, not proof of accessibility or a completed manual review. Unknown rules, new reasons, changed DOM references, and growth beyond the stated envelopes require triage. Confirmed violations always fail. Review actual contrast and screen-reader behavior manually.

color-contrast.reason: The site background includes a pseudo-element layer. axe cannot determine the composited background for these nodes; their contrast remains unresolved until checked visually and with a contrast tool across the background. The 2026-10-30 growth review found 52 nodes in eight new timeline milestones, eight new year-heading nodes, four Show/Order control nodes, and six additional About introduction nodes, all with the same pseudoContent reason. Sampled shared tags met contrast requirements in default, hover, focus and selected states; this does not complete the page-wide manual review. The envelopes allow modest content/date variation, not new failure types.

aria-valid-attr-value.reason: The closed native search dialog is outside the rendered accessibility tree. The browser test asserts the referenced dialog ID exists in the DOM and audits the dialog after opening it.
aria-valid-attr-value.manualStatus: DOM reference verified; screen-reader announcement review pending
